claims.text: Adding a small amount of boron to a lightweight high-entropy alloy will improve its mechanical performance relative to an unmodified baseline.
Adding a small amount of boron will improve the corrosion resistance of a lightweight high-entropy alloy relative to an unmodified baseline.
Adding a small amount of boron will improve the high-temperature oxidation resistance of a lightweight high-entropy alloy relative to an unmodified baseline.
A boron-modified lightweight high-entropy alloy will retain low density.
Boron addition will refine the grain structure of a lightweight high-entropy alloy.
Boron addition will form boron-rich phases in a lightweight high-entropy alloy.
The proposed grain refinement and boron-rich phases will enhance alloy strength.
The proposed grain refinement and boron-rich phases will enhance corrosion resistance.
The proposed grain refinement and boron-rich phases will enhance high-temperature oxidation resistance.
The boron content must be optimized to avoid an excessive increase in weight.
